lc_outlier.title: Spends far more or less than similar councils
lc_outlier.text: After allowing for the number of residents (or children, or older people), this council's spending on a service is far from the typical council of its kind.

lc_jump.title: Sudden change in spending
lc_jump.text: Total service spending moved far more in a year, in real terms, than is usual for councils of its kind. Reorganisations and mergers are a common innocent cause.

lc_reserves.title: Thin reserves
lc_reserves.text: Reserves that councils can use are small compared with what they spend, leaving little cushion against a shock.

lc_dsg.title: Schools funding deficit
lc_dsg.text: The council holds a deficit on the Dedicated Schools Grant (mainly special educational needs), which is carried on its books and can exceed its reserves.

lc_interest.title: Heavy debt-servicing cost
lc_interest.text: Net interest paid is a large share of what the council spends on running services.

lc_invest.title: Investment properties costing more than they earn
lc_invest.text: The council holds commercial investment property that costs more to carry than it brings in.

lc_missing.title: Accounts not submitted
lc_missing.text: The council has not submitted its revenue outturn return to the government for a year when most councils have.
